title: POV: You Take a Loss Right Before CPI Week (Then This Happens)
description: POV: You just blew a trade heading into CPI week. But what if that loss was actually the setup? The R2F Trading system reveals how smart money uses volatility events like CPI to trap retailers — and how one concept changes everything. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily ICT setups.
script: Stop. Before you trade this week — CPI drops in 48 hours. I lost $2,300 Monday morning last CPI week. Thought I had the setup. Smart money swept liquidity BEFORE the news. I was the exit. That's the trap. CPI doesn't move price. Smart money moves price — CPI is the excuse. Now watch the order block BEFORE the CPI candle. That's the real entry. Losing that trade taught me how smart money positions. Now CPI week is my favourite week. Follow R2F Trading. We post real ICT setups every single day at r2ftrading.com.
